services.name: Discovery Tandem
services.desc: We are open Thursday - Monday from 9 am to 5 pm. We are closed on Tuesday & Wednesday. Other hours are available by appointment only. Every flight booked will be charged a $50 booking fee. You will receive an invoice to pay via text or email and may use a credit card to pay the booking fee. Failure to pay the booking fee will forfeit your booked flight time. After 25 minutes, the invoice is no longer valid. The $50 per flight booking fee will be taken off the final sales total at checkout for your scheduled flight. You can choose to use the booking fee towards the final flight total, tipping the pilots and ground crew, towards a t-shirt, upgrading your flight, or a video. Failure to show up

blurb: Guests take tandem hang gliding flights to altitudes of 2500, 3500, or 5280 feet, launched by aerotow using Dragonfly planes. Flights are supervised by certified instructors who perform safety checks and provide safety equipment. Personal cameras are not allowed, but an in-flight video package is available for purchase.
